title: APP_DEBUG=false turns debug mode on
body: `load_settings` in `appconfig/settings.py` converts environment overrides with the type of the default value. For booleans this calls `bool(raw)`, so any non-empty string, including `"false"`, becomes `True`. Boolean overrides should accept `true`, `1`, `yes`, `on` and `false`, `0`, `no`, `off` in any letter case, and raise `ValueError` for anything else. Other types must keep their current behaviour.
